items.title: Wall Street is cooling on Jensen Huang's Nvidia — but history says don't give up on the stock just yet
items.summary: Morgan Stanley and Bank of America pulled Nvidia from their best-ideas lists, but nearly all analysts still rate the stock a Buy.

items.title: Applied Materials Is Up 59% in a Year, Even After Halving From Its High: “Double Our Output”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApplied Materials stock is up 59% over the past year, even after losing about half its value since its June 30 record close. Record quarters drove the climb, and worries about AI spending, sparked partly by Lam Research’s outlook, drove the fall, with no bad news from Applied itself.

items.title: Deutsche Bank Names Top US Chip Stocks Amid Market Volatility

items.title: The Next AI Chip Shortage May Be the Machines That Make HBM
items.summary: Every HBM stack must be thinned, etched, bonded, and inspected before it ever reaches an AI accelerator. Orders for the tools behind those steps are racing ahead of sales, and the winners may not be the names investors expect.
